subject.title: Feature Request: User-Level Skill Preferences/Conventions Support

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class per-skill user preferences/conventions context surface, and if so should the canonical shape be a markdown file beside the user skill or an existing config/plugin path?
rationale: The request affects prompt composition, token budgeting, skill precedence, watcher refresh behavior, and a new user-facing preference/config surface, so automation should not choose the permanent contract.

options.title: Approve markdown preference files
options.body: Standardize a bounded `preferences.md` or `conventions.md` overlay with clear precedence, snapshot, path, and docs semantics.

options.title: Use existing config/skill surfaces
options.body: Decline a new file convention and document how users should express this through full user skills, `skills.entries.<key>.config`, or workspace-specific skill copies.

options.title: Move to plugin/ClawHub design
options.body: Keep core unchanged unless a plugin or bundle-style extension API proves it cannot express the preference overlay safely.

recommendation.title: Approve markdown preference files
recommendation.body: Standardize a bounded `preferences.md` or `conventions.md` overlay with clear precedence, snapshot, path, and docs semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The latest shipped skill loader and docs snapshot is the strongest available routing signal for this skill-loading contract decision.
